title: The Truth
subtitle: Some mistake pain for a truth serum.

items.text: The Truth
Chandigarh Police Station
Janardhan sits slumped in a chair, bound tight. Blood dripping from his nose, over cracked lips, and through his teeth, mixing with spit at the corner of his mouth.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Heh ... heh ...
The new interrogator wipes blood off his knuckles with delicate care.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: You bit my partner's ear off, Janardhan. That means I don't have to play nice anymore.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: I don't have his patience.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: Let's review and clear your head a bit, Janardhan.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: We found you in the jungle with a kidnapped student and an empty bag.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: But that girl is nowhere to be found. And that student is still unconscious—hasn't said a word.
The interrogator narrows his eyes.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: So ... want to explain that bullet in your shoulder?

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: You're going to tell me what happened, and then you're going to tell me where that money is.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: *cough* I'll tell you everything. I'll tell you everything!

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: First of all, it was that dumb brat from the train that shot me.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Stop running, both of you!

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Or I'll shoot. I'll shoot you both! See if I care!?
They kept running toward the river, and I was right behind them, dragging the bag.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: We have to cross! He's carrying too much—he can't keep up!

items.speaker: Student
items.text: B-But I can't swim!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Shut your eyes! Just kick your legs and move! Don't think—just swim!
I chased after them, but the bag was too heavy and the current was too strong.
I was close. So close I could almost grab the brat's arm.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: What? My bag—
Just as I was about to grab him, the bag snagged on a rotten log.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Of all the rotten—Urghh!
I yanked at the bag, prying it free, but as I turned back ...
I felt the weight of my gun was missing.

items.speaker: Student
items.text: Don't come any closer! I'll shoot. Don't think I won't, you thief!
He's just a kid—there's not a chance he has the guts to pull that trigger.
So I took another step—
*thud*

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: *cough* I couldn't chase them after that, so I just dragged myself back to shore.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Didn't even notice my bag was torn open.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: And just like that ... all that cash—everything—washed away in the river.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Then I found a tree. Something to rest up against. When I came to—*cough*

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Well ...

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: You think I'm some kind of idiot? You're trying to tell me all that money is in the belly of some fish out there?

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: Your story stinks. For one thing, we heard three shots.

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Heh ... Well, that kid couldn't aim for s**t.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: We could still work something out, Janardhan. You sure you want to keep selling me this bulls**t?

items.speaker: Janardhan
items.text: Heh ... heh ...
*knock*

items.speaker: Young Officer
items.text: Sir ... there's a crowd outside. It's a whole bunch of vagrants and now some reporters. They're blocking the street. It's turning into a real scene.

items.speaker: Officer II
items.text: Hm?

items.speaker: Young Officer
items.text: That kid woke up.

items.speaker: Young Officer
items.text: Also, a woman named Batia is here. She's asked to meet with the chief.

items.speaker: Young Officer
items.text: He wants you in his office.
